full_name: Cristina Grasseni | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Social Sciences David and Roberta Logie Fellow and Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Università degli studi di Bergamo (Italy)
bio: Cristina Grasseni is a researcher in anthropology at Università degli studi di Bergamo, where she lectures in the PhD school in anthropology and epistemology of complexity.
